description:
You will be responsible for bringing company's brand to life across our digital marketing channels. 
- This is a 100% remote, full-time role of 40 hours per week.
- Your stakeholders are based in Jakarta, Indonesia, Bangkok, Thailand, and Mexico City, Mexico. You must choose a working schedule to overlap with all 3 time zones, including overlap with the Mexico City time zone for at least two hours each working day. 

Must Have
• 2–5 years of experience as a Graphic Designer, preferably within B2B technology, SaaS, AI, or enterprise software.
• A strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality visual design across digital marketing assets, particularly social media content, eBooks, reports, email campaigns, and other marketing collateral.
• Advanced proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign.
• Experience designing eDMs, with best practices and responsive layouts.
• Strong understanding of typography, layout, composition, colour, and visual hierarchy.
• Ability to translate marketing briefs and written content into clean, engaging, and visually compelling designs.
• Excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-moving environment.
• Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
• Ability to work 40 hours per week in a fully remote environment, with at least two hours of overlap with the Mexico City time zone each working day.

Nice to Have
• Experience using AI-powered creative tools.
• Hands-on experience within HubSpot.
• Experience designing infographics, illustrations, or motion graphics.
• Experience creating presentation decks, event collateral, exhibition booth graphics, or sales enablement materials.
• Basic understanding of HTML and the technical considerations involved in email design.

Please share original work relevant to this role, including:
• LinkedIn visuals
• eBooks
• Marketing eDMs.
title: Graphic Designer (full-time freelance)
